system_diagram: The standard receiver passes the received grid through DMRS channel estimation, LMMSE equalization, demapping and LDPC decoding. The detector computes power from the grid, the DMRS residual from raw LS pilot estimates, and EVM from the equalized symbols and their noise variance. A U-Net and threshold produce a 24 by 14 jamming map. The dashed paths show how the receiver uses the map to set pilot and data variances on a second pass through the same slot.
shrinkage_example: The estimated jamming power of the data cells of one PRB row, (a) under a block jammer that hits every data symbol and (b) under a hopping jammer that hits 2 of them (+9 dB JSR, TDL-C, 15 dB SNR). The circles show each cell's own estimate, the dashed line the row mean and the squares the values after shrinkage, all in units of the jammer's power per resource element, and the jammed symbols are shaded.
attack_maps: One slot under pilot jamming of PRBs 10-13 at +6 dB JSR (TDL-C, 20 dB SNR, the UE on PRBs 6-17), with the jammed cells outlined. The U-Net marks 4 of the 4 jammed DMRS cells, while the EVM threshold marks 15 data cells that the jammer never touched.
